note: The purple sandpipers' voice (B3 wave 3; doc 17 'Procedural creature voices'). Made in code with the turnstones' call maker (src/audio/voices/turnstone.js, the same fields as recipes/audio/turnstone.json), not recordings, so there is no licence to carry. Quieter and lower than the turnstones: chatter is the soft 'kwit' notes a few birds give as the flock flushes low over the water (fewer, wider-spaced notes than a turnstone's rattle); tuk is a feeding bird's 'wit' now and then; murmur is a few quiet twitters at the roost on the wall. spatial: refDistance and rolloff of the placed chain.
